acceptance: PostgreSQL TPC-H .tbl load does no per-line Python split/join.
Loaded row counts and values match current behavior, including booleans and compressed input.
description: benchbox/platforms/base/data_loading.py:1869-1907 rewrites compressed files, .tbl files with a trailing '|', and files needing boolean normalisation one line at a time with split/join. Callers: PostgreSQL family (postgresql.py:720; strip_trailing for .tbl at :655) — every TPC-H table on PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Citus and other subclasses; SingleStore (singlestore.py:224); DataFusion (datafusion.py:1264, compressed only). Stream-decompress straight into copy.write, strip trailing delimiters per chunk with a bytes regex, or declare a dummy trailing column. The Parquet path (_write_parquet_to_copy, postgresql.py:73-84) is already vectorized.
